verdict.rationale: TeamViewer publishes its own Web API documentation at a hosted docs index, so an API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
